:::{#hero-heading}

Wesley is a data engineer and Marine Corps veteran who builds the pipelines, integrations, and cloud infrastructure that turn scattered source data into clean, scalable systems. With experience spanning financial data engineering, automation, and business intelligence, he owns the full data stack, from ingestion to delivery.

His path into data started in the military, where he managed the lifecycle of data that drove large-scale, global logistics. He went on to earn a master's in business analytics, a program grounded largely in using data science to solve complex business problems. Meanwhile, he transitioned back to the private sector, starting as an operations analyst and building the data engineering and analytics work he owns today. This portfolio is where the data science background takes center stage, through the machine learning and modeling work he builds on his own.

Outside of work, he enjoys gardening, woodworking, bird watching, and exploring San Diego’s hiking trails.
